entry.title: LLM API Rate Limits: How to Fix OpenAI and Claude 429 Errors
entry.summary: A 429 Too Many Requests error means you sent more requests or tokens than your limit allows in the current time window. OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter all return it, and it usually shows up the first time an app runs under real load or a batch job fans out across several workers.
